title: Toy slot map - one block on 512x512:64

provenance.author: fws_toy_slotmap.build_fixture, from fws_slot_mapper.map_chain
grounded: chips[], macros[] and tiles[] are the enumerated placement the slot mapper produced: one tile per OCCUPIED slot
slots.macros[].slots carry the firing tick of token 0, and slot index equals tick modulo mux on every one of them
slots.ledgers are re-derived from those tables by an independent checker before this document is written
cards[].area_mm2 is the analog sheet port evaluated at this macro geometry
provenance.note: THE ATLAS'S SLOT FIXTURE. One block of the toy debug chain, emitted by the same mapper the sweep uses, so the loader's slot rules are proved against a document that obeys the contract. It is not a result: read relaxations[] before quoting anything.

analog_512x512x64.label: analog macro, 512 rows x 512 columns : 64 ADCs
analog_512x512x64.basis: area_mm2 is the analog sheet port evaluated at 512 rows x 512 columns behind 64 ADCs, so mux = 8 is derived. One cell stores one 8-bit weight, so the card does not slice.

systems.label: Toy slot map - one block on 512x512:64

metrics.label: beat, one token exits per beat
metrics.basis: beat = mux 8 x tick 20 ns; the macro geometry fixes it

metrics.label: steady throughput (HEADLINE)
metrics.basis: 1 / beat. beat = mux 8 x tick 20 ns; the macro geometry fixes it

metrics.label: one user's token rate
metrics.basis: 1 / (D 9 x beat 160 ns): a user's next token re-enters on the first bundle's phase, and that phase comes round once per beat, so D users share the throughput and D x this rate is the throughput, read off the emitted tick schedule, which an independent checker verified

metrics.label: ceiling on one user's token rate
metrics.basis: 1 / (L 69 ticks x 20 ns): the rate a user would get if the next token could start the instant the last one left, and only a beat that divides L reaches it, read off the emitted tick schedule, which an independent checker verified

metrics.label: chain latency L
metrics.basis: last firing tick of the last bundle plus one, from tick 0 of the first; read off the emitted tick schedule, which an independent checker verified

metrics.label: chain latency lower bound
metrics.basis: two ticks per bundle plus one seam per unavoidable chip crossing, relaxing the chip capacity to a bin-packing bound

metrics.label: sequences in flight D
metrics.basis: ceil(L / beat ticks): latency does not set the beat, it sets how many sequences are in flight

metrics.label: sequences in flight at the latency bound
cells committed that hold no weight
metrics.basis: ragged remainder of each bundle against Z, plus every slot stranded when a bundle moved whole to a fresh chip

metrics.label: share of committed cells that are waste
metrics.basis: wasted cells over every cell the mapping commits; the bound is zero

metrics.label: chip crossings on the chain
metrics.basis: bundles whose chip differs from the previous bundle's; each costs 25 ticks of latency and nothing of the beat

metrics.label: chip crossings at the capacity bound
metrics.basis: one fewer than the fewest chips these slot-layers could fit in

metrics.label: enumerated analog chiplets
metrics.basis: the mapper opened them one by one; a chip count here is never a division

metrics.label: macros holding at least one slot-layer
occupied slots
metrics.basis: one per slot-layer, one tile each

metrics.label: slots stranded behind a moved bundle
metrics.basis: free slots left on a chip when the next bundle did not fit whole

metrics.label: silicon of the macros the mapping occupies
metrics.basis: 18 macros x 0.3197 mm2 from the analog sheet port

metrics.label: ticks a bundle waited for its phase
metrics.basis: summed start_tick minus earliest legal tick over the chain

relaxations.value: a mapper debug chain, not a machine
relaxations.reason: This sweep exists to exercise the slot mapper and its independent checker. Its twelve bundles are three blocks of qkv, out, ffn1 and ffn2 at a hidden size chosen to equal the macro height, so every bundle's K fits one macro exactly. No number here describes any real model, and none of it should be quoted as a result.

relaxations.value: 6 macros per chip, a debug override
relaxations.reason: The chip capacity is passed to the mapper directly by the toy so that seams and stranded slots happen on a short chain. It is not the die area budget the real platform work derives, and it must not be read as one.

Wire hops, reduce trees and chip seams add latency only; they never bound the beat. The mapping assumes the fabric carries every handoff inside the two-tick hop and the twenty-five-tick seam it is charged. No bandwidth number is derived anywhere here, and the assumption is recorded rather than hidden.

relaxations.value: no digital chiplet, no state store, no energy, no bytes
relaxations.reason: The toy places analog weight macros and schedules their firings. It composes no digital engine, sizes no state store, prices no energy and counts no bytes across the seams it reports. Those panels are empty because the quantity is absent, not because it measured zero.

Silicon is the count of macros holding at least one slot-layer times the macro area the analog sheet port derives at that geometry. Empty macro slots on the chips the mapper opened are enumerated and reported, and they are not charged.

subtitle: One block of the toy debug chain - qkv 768 columns, out 512, ffn1 2048 and ffn2 as four K-blocks of 512 whose partials reduce - placed slot by slot on macros of 512 rows x 512 columns behind 64 ADCs. mux = 8, so the beat is 160 ns. ffn1 does not fit the slots the first chiplet has left, so it moves whole and pays a crossing, and ffn2 does the same: 3 chiplets, 2 crossings, 44 stranded slots.

run.tool_version: the slot fixture the atlas loader is proved on
run.basis: one mapping of one block, rebuilt whenever the slot contract moves so the fixture and the sweep cannot disagree
